title: Archi action class (one entry of a pack's action_classes file)
description: A typed action an automation may propose (ADR 0002 section 7.2). The file's top-level `action_classes:` mapping is keyed by the action-class id.

payload_schema.description: JSON Schema (an object schema) the proposal payload must satisfy.

mediator.description: What carries the action out: a live tool entry (archi.tools.x:fn) of this pack or a required pack, or the name of a workflow step.

blast_radius.description: What the action can touch if it goes wrong.

max_level.description: Highest autonomy level the class may have: L0, L1 or L2. Anything above L2 is refused (ADR 0002 D13).
